name: Python Mastery Course
shortDescription: Go from beginner to advanced Python developer in 40 hours.
longDescription: A comprehensive 40-hour video course covering Python fundamentals, OOP, async programming, testing with pytest, and building REST APIs with FastAPI. Includes 120 coding exercises and a capstone project.

reviews.author: Ben T.
reviews.comment: Very thorough, some sections could be tighter.

name: Vue 3 Complete Guide
shortDescription: Master Vue 3 Composition API, Pinia, and Vue Router.
longDescription: From the Options API to the Composition API, this guide covers every feature of Vue 3 including Teleport, Suspense, script setup syntax, and integration with TypeScript. Build three real-world projects.

reviews.author: Clara M.
reviews.comment: Finally a course that explains reactivity clearly.

name: System Design Interview Handbook
shortDescription: 450-page PDF guide to cracking system design rounds.
longDescription: Covers distributed systems fundamentals, CAP theorem, database sharding, caching strategies, message queues, and 25 real interview walkthroughs with diagrams. Used by 50,000+ engineers.

reviews.author: Eva L.
reviews.comment: Great content, diagrams could be higher resolution.

name: Clean Code Principles eBook
shortDescription: Practical guide to writing maintainable, readable code.
longDescription: Covering SOLID principles, refactoring patterns, naming conventions, test-driven development, and code review best practices with examples in Python, TypeScript, and Java.

name: DevOps Pro License — Annual
shortDescription: 1-year license for the DevOps Pro CI/CD pipeline tool.
longDescription: DevOps Pro automates deployment pipelines for up to 10 repositories. Includes Docker integration, Kubernetes deployment manifests, Slack notifications, and rollback support. Annual license, renewed automatically.

reviews.author: Grace H.
reviews.comment: Saved our team 10 hours a week.

name: CodeSnip IDE Extension License
shortDescription: Lifetime license for the CodeSnip VS Code extension.
longDescription: CodeSnip provides AI-powered code snippet suggestions, multi-language support, and team snippet sharing. One-time purchase, lifetime updates included.

reviews.author: Iris T.
reviews.comment: Incredibly useful, saves so many keystrokes.

name: TypeScript Deep Dive
shortDescription: Advanced TypeScript patterns for professional developers.
longDescription: Covers generics, conditional types, mapped types, template literal types, declaration merging, module augmentation, and building type-safe libraries. Targeted at developers who already know TypeScript basics.

name: The Pragmatic Developer eBook
shortDescription: Career and technical guidance for modern software engineers.
longDescription: Topics include career laddering, technical debt management, working in distributed teams, debugging systematically, and building internal tools that scale. Written by a FAANG principal engineer.

reviews.author: Lena P.
reviews.comment: Changed how I think about my career.

name: DBQuery Pro — Lifetime License
shortDescription: Visual SQL query builder and database explorer, one-time purchase.
longDescription: DBQuery Pro connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB. Features include an ER diagram viewer, query plan explainer, CSV/JSON export, and SSH tunneling. Lifetime license includes all future major versions.

reviews.author: Mark S.
reviews.comment: Replaced DataGrip for me at a fraction of the cost.

reviews.author: Nina W.
reviews.comment: MongoDB support is a bit rough but rest is great.
